description: Build an authentic multi-style blend from two to five Omoro styles. The first two styles anchor the visual direction; added styles are treated as influence layers. Returns defining rendering techniques, visible contribution requirements, fidelity checks, palette and three coordinated mockup prompts: one hero and two distinct supporting applications, presented as a large hero left and two stacked applications right.

mix.description: Percentage led by the second primary style.

styles.description: Two to five style slugs. The first two are the primary pair.

name: blend_styles
